integrity: The proof is analytic and elementary; finite exact-arithmetic tests are corroboration rather than exhaustive proof. The local finite-field orbit symmetry is re-established in the package.
scientific_limitations: The bound is uniform in the positive integer starting value and all exponents of h, but need not be optimal for each fixed h or each large prime. Equality is exhibited at p=5, without an asymptotic optimality claim. It applies only when the recurrence parameter is a positive square. Earlier full-text literature may contain implicit equivalent bounds.
title: A universal prime-quarter deadline for square failures in reciprocal-sum sequences
